facts.statement: The genus Asterosteus was described by Newberry in 1875.
The type species of the genus is Asterosteus stenocephalus.
Fossils of Asterosteus date to the Eifelian stage.
Asterosteus is a genus of rhenanid placoderm that lived during the Eifelian.
facts.quote: Asterosteus is a genus of rhenanid placoderm from the Eifelian.

facts.statement: The type species A. stenocephalus is known from an incomplete skull found in Middle Devonian strata in Ohio.
facts.quote: The type species, A. stenocephalus, is known from an incomplete skull from Middle Devonian strata in Ohio.

facts.statement: A possible second species, Asterosteus sp., is known from fragments with star-shaped tubercles found in the Eifelian-aged Gebze beds of Turkey.
facts.quote: What may be a second species ("Asterosteus sp. Schmidtt 1963") is described from fragments decorated with star-shaped tubercules from the Eifelian-aged Gebze beds of Turkey.

facts.statement: Asterosteus belongs to the family Asterosteidae.
Asterosteus is classified within the class Placodermi.
